name: seo-audit-api
title: SEO Audit API - On-Page Score, Issues and Fixes
description: Most SEO checkers fetch raw html, so a javascript page scores as an empty shell and you still pay for the row. This one opens every url in its own Chromium: a 0-100 score, each issue with severity and a fix, and a page it could not read comes back free with a reason.

meta.memoryJustification: A Chromium renderer is what performs the audit: one browser stays open for the whole run, so 1024 MB is not enough for more than a single tab and the run would die mid page without a summary.
